parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: <short pause> for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety. <short pause> Psalm four, verse eight. <long pause>
Lord, <short pause> as I lie down tonight, let me rest in Your safety <short pause> and wake in Your peace. <long pause> Amen.
